name: 🍓 Greek Yogurt Parfaits
what: Vanilla yogurt, berries and crunchy granola layered in glasses.
early: Night before (optional): layer yogurt and berries in jars; add granola in the morning.

core.name: Vanilla Greek yogurt
core.out: plain yogurt with a little honey

core.name: Berries
core.out: any fruit, or thawed frozen berries

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
In 4 glasses: yogurt, then berries, then granola. Repeat.
Last sprinkle of granola right before eating.

key: Granola goes on last so it stays crunchy.
done: Berries on top and the granola still crunches.
plan_b: No granola or fruit? Yogurt with honey and cinnamon.
